title: PIVOTSBench Task 1 record
description: One directional relationship (subject -> target) inside one clip, scored on all six PIVOTS dimensions. A benchmark item is one (record, dimension) pair, so N records yield 6N Task 1 items.

youtube_id.description: 11-character YouTube identifier. Null when the clip is not resolvable to a public URL.

clip_file.description: Expected filename of the locally obtained clip under videos/, e.g. 4AmVjblOvy4_0_30s.mp4. See data/README.md for how to obtain clips.

subject.description: The character whose perception is being scored (A in A -> B)

timestamp_sec.description: Frame that best supports the score. Ground truth for Task 2.

cues.description: Ground truth for Task 3. Two cues per item in the released benchmark.
